newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Sept 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Sept 23.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- European Union finance ministers agree on monetary stability pact to guarantee budget discipline by countries joining euro currency in 1999.
-- Drop in PSA Peugeot Citroen and Renault half-year profits due to lack of competitiveness, price competition. PSA posted a 602-million-franc profit for the first half today.

-- France Telecom state-owned operator in talks with Olivetti that could lead it to buying an equity stake in the Italian group, may seek alliances in the mobile phone sector with Olivetti units Infostrada and Omnitel.
